meta.title: Agricultural Engineer
meta.tagline: Engineer sustainable farming systems and food production.
meta.description: Agricultural engineers apply engineering principles to farming, irrigation, food processing and agricultural machinery. They design systems that improve crop yield, reduce waste and make agriculture more sustainable — from precision agriculture and IoT-based monitoring to farm machinery automation and post-harvest technology.

details.description: Agricultural engineers apply engineering principles to farming, irrigation, food processing and agricultural machinery.
